subject: Time consuming 3D labeling making it hard to scale?
text:
Hi Ananya, 

A lot of teams I speak to seem to be struggling with the volume of 3D cuboid annotation as datasets get bigger. 

Manually drawing cuboids frame by frame just doesn’t hold up once you’re working with long sequences, dense point clouds, or frequent iteration. 

That’s why we put together a 20-minute masterclass for the 19th of Feb showing how teams are shifting to autolabeling-first workflows: 

Models generate cuboids automatically 

Humans review, adjust, and approve 

Temporal context helps keep things consistent across frames
